name: selected_route_id
description: The unique identifier for the SelectedRoute resource. Logical primary key. Pattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$'.

name: display_name
description: User-provided descriptive name for the route. Intended for human readability.

name: record_time
description: The UTC timestamp representing when the road data was collected, fully reconstructed via COALESCE from retrieval_timestamp (RFC 3339) or legacy retrieval_time with microsecond precision.

name: duration_in_seconds
description: The near real-time traffic-aware duration of the route in seconds, resolved via COALESCE from duration_in_seconds or legacy travel_duration. Omitted/NULL when has_road_closure is true.

name: static_duration_in_seconds
description: The traffic-unaware (static) duration of the route in seconds, representing estimated travel time under free-flow conditions, resolved via COALESCE from static_duration_in_seconds or legacy travel_duration.

name: has_road_closure
description: Indicates whether the route is subject to a full road closure. When true, duration_in_seconds and speed_reading_offsets are omitted.

name: route_geometry
description: The actual optimal path determined by the routing engine as a native BigQuery GEOGRAPHY polyline object (EPSG:4326).

name: road_segment_ids
description: Place IDs along the route in topological order indicating connected road segments.

name: speed_reading_offsets
description: Speed reading intervals defined by linear distance offsets along the route polyline. Omitted when has_road_closure is true.

fields.name: start_offset
fields.description: Starting offset in meters from the beginning of the route (inclusive).

fields.name: end_offset
fields.description: Ending offset in meters from the beginning of the route (exclusive; equals start_offset of subsequent interval).

fields.name: speed
fields.description: The categorical classification of speed for this interval. Possible values: 'NORMAL', 'SLOW', 'TRAFFIC_JAM', 'TRAFFIC_JAM_HEAVY'.

name: speed_reading_intervals
description: Legacy repeated RECORD containing road sub-segments categorized by traffic speed boundaries (deprecated; retained for backward compatibility during transitional window).

fields.name: interval_coordinates
fields.description: The native GEOGRAPHY representation of the specific road segment for this speed interval, constructed as a standard EPSG:4326 line string.

fields.name: speed
fields.description: The categorical classification of speed for this interval. Possible values: 'NORMAL', 'SLOW', 'TRAFFIC_JAM'.
